title: l1qw.16.3: GCP-6.3 silent discard — signature-failed slot claims are dropped, not 4.01'd
description: Child of l1qw.16 (GCP-6.3): rust/lichen-gateway/src/resources.rs handle_post_slots returns CoapResponse::unauthorized() (4.01, resources.rs:1963) when candidate_verifier.verify fails; spec GCP-6.3 (quoted in python/src/lichen/gateway/slot_claim.py docstring): claims with invalid or missing signatures MUST be SILENTLY DISCARDED. Change the signature-failure path to a silent drop (no response / empty success per the handler's contract — pick what the surrounding resource framework supports and document). Scope check: the OSCORE-missing 4.01s (resources.rs:1946,1949) are transport-layer auth and MAY stay — only the signature-verification failure must discard silently. Mirror in Python wherever a reject maps to an error response rather than discard. Tests: failed-signature POST yields no protocol error response.
